attribution_limit: An identical grid may have been produced by another generator; equality with attempt2 alone does not prove the local branch was selected.
interpretation: The current local generator can emit an incomplete-training candidate, and the runtime can directly assign it as the second attempt. The v7 train-exact constraint is not enforced on that branch. LOO conflicts signal risk rather than automatically proving the test prediction wrong.
limitations: The scoring counts are public training posthoc, not official scores.
The candidate repair is under development and has not yet passed matched regression or Kaggle private run.
